name: slag
description: Experimental agentic plugins and tools that are not meant for public consumption.

plugins.name: assay
plugins.description: Analyzes the instruction files an agent loads — CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/, AGENTS.md, skills and hooks — flagging what is vague, stale, buried, or better served by a mechanism, and rewriting the weak ones. /assay:opus5, /assay:sonnet5, /assay:haiku45 and /assay:fable5 audit this host, one per model; /assay:codex audits the other; craft-rules and craft-skill write new ones.

plugins.name: jig
plugins.description: Interviews you about the mistakes your repo keeps making, then sets up what catches them: linter, type checker, tests, CI and checks written for your code. Works on an empty folder. Every check proves itself on a planted violation, nothing lands unapproved, and a plain question gets a short answer.

plugins.name: anneal
plugins.description: Audits how easy an existing repository is for an AI agent to find its way around — map file, toolchain version, names, layout, build output, check commands — then proposes a layout you approve and migrates in small commits, each checked against the project's own tests.

plugins.name: collet
plugins.description: Holds a session inside the task it was given: one open task with the files it may touch and the command that ends it, a guard that refuses writes outside that list, and checks that each ship with a violation and a near miss so none of them counts as coverage before it has been shown to work. On a project that already keeps a ROADMAP.jsonl it writes no ledger of its own and enforces the files that roadmap declares.
